\section[\texorpdfstring{\sk{सन्देशः} (sandeśaḥ)}{सन्देशः (sandeśaḥ)}]{\sk{सन्देशः} (sandeśaḥ) — a message}

\label{lesson:SA-C171-sandesah}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for a livelihood, then the Sanskrit for service.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{सन्देशः}}
\textbf{\sk{सन्देशः}} — \emph{sandeśaḥ} — \textquotedblleft{}a message\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{sandeśa} comes from \emph{sam-√diś} \textquotedblleft{}point out, direct, send word\textquotedblright{}, the root √diś \textquotedblleft{}point, show\textquotedblright{} with \emph{sam} \textquotedblleft{}together\textquotedblright{} (MW): \textquotedblleft{}a communication, a message, an errand\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
